content.rationale: Rationale: Explicit subject-key conflicts must remain inspectable even when lexical or vector ranking returns only one side. The context response keeps its existing conflict ID field stable while adding serialized conflict records. Security audit was scoped to this repository lockfile; the earlier blocker came from auditing the parent workspace lockfile, not this project.
content.semantic_summary: [feat] Closed Phase 3 retrieval trust gaps. Context now returns the complete same-project conflict group, preserves the conflict ID list, identifies expanded peers, and warns when details exceed the character budget. Added synthetic conflict and supersession accuracy metrics and regression coverage. Committed and pushed to GitLab and GitHub master as 80aaebb684f0df5a0f9b19dd3891b4e69b467933.
